letter.subject: EU261 compensation claim - flight W64567 on 2026-10-22
letter.body:
Dear Wizz Air Customer Relations,

We act on behalf of our client regarding flight W64567 on 2026-10-22 from Tirana (TIA) to Rome (FCO), which was delayed, arriving 3 hours and 30 minutes late.

Under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, Articles 5, 7 and the case law of the Court of Justice of the EU, the passenger is entitled to compensation of EUR 250 for this long delay. The flight distance is 623 km.

Based on the information available to us, no extraordinary circumstances apply.

Please pay EUR 250 within 14 days of this letter and send your reply to our claims team.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Team
